summary: Checked the 3 fixes from iteration 161 plus regression. FIX 1 (bridge.js speech_started while waiting for hello): at first the old behaviour was still there because the running nodejs process (started 21:07:08) was older than the bridge.js fix (saved 21:21:55, commit a9f0ebaa), so the note that Node had been restarted was wrong. After `supervisorctl restart nodejs` the same repro (waitForHello:true, q.ulaw 4.85 s starting at 0.5 s) logged '[AIAgent] opening after hello', and the opening transcript (10.6 s) came after the caller transcript (9.7 s). No agent audio overlapped the caller. With 6 s of silence the log showed 'opening after no hello' and the opening came once at about 5.3 s (4 s timer plus latency). With waitForHello:false the opening came first (1.3 s). The next turn began 'Hi Alex, ...', a short greeting back with no second self-introduction. FIX 2: FR and ES placeholder and script-guide example now keep the fallback ({lead_name|à vous} / {lead_name|qué tal}); EN is unchanged. FIX 3: ai-test-outbound-note ends with 'Tests use the saved settings.' (FR and ES translated). It reflects the SAVED waitForHello: an unsaved toggle does not change it, and after saving and reloading it changes. Regression: pytest test_ai_agent_first_message.py 13/13 passed and node test_ai_opening_unit.js 13/13 passed.

minor.issue: nodejs had not been restarted after the bridge.js fix (process start 21:07:08, file mtime 21:21:55). The testing agent restarted it. js/ has no hot reload, so restart nodejs after every js/ change.

With empty FAQs the model still says things like 'We are open on Saturdays' / 'We do have openings on Saturday', which are invented facts. In the early-question waitForHello run, the agent gave the opening after the caller's question and then waited, so the question was not answered within the 16 s window. This is expected by design (opening, then listen), but in a real call the lead has to repeat the question.

action_items: Always restart nodejs (sudo supervisorctl restart nodejs) after editing js/ files before handing off for testing
Optional: the model still invents facts when FAQs are empty (known model-compliance issue)
critical_code_review_comments: bridge.js: the speech_started branch now clears helloTimer and sets a 10 s 'long hello' safety timer while waiting. speech_stopped opens the call. This looks correct.
The 10 s safety timer is hardcoded, while HELLO_WAIT_MS comes from env. Consider an env or constant for consistency (minor).
